name: SteelSeries Apex (original) / Apex 350
description: The five lighting zones (QWERTY, ten-key, function keys, MX keys, logo) of the original SteelSeries Apex / Apex Fnatic and the Apex 350. Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesOldApexController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only the zone colour report is sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/steelseries-apex-old.md.
